rules.description: DME power wheelchair requests require prior authorization and supporting diagnosis plus functional mobility evidence.

requiredClinicalContext.label: Diagnosis context
requiredClinicalContext.detail: Attach at least one active or recent diagnosis relevant to the mobility limitation.

requiredClinicalContext.label: Functional mobility evidence
requiredClinicalContext.detail: Include evidence of mobility limitation, failed lower-level assistive devices, or home mobility need.
